maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from subscriptions to investment research, data, ratings and indexes, plus asset management; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are investors, advisors, asset managers and corporations paying for research, data and software; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly organic from data, research, indexes and PitchBook; acquisitions such as PitchBook, DBRS and Sustainalytics are occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: PitchBook, Morningstar Data and Direct platforms are embedded in advisor and asset manager workflows; ratings and indexes are hard to replace.
